description: A Dhaka Tribune discovery result dated 30 January announced Islami Andolan Bangladesh programs across districts/metropolitan areas, including a Dhaka rally scheduled for the following Saturday and a 7 February round-table. The announcement is not evidence that the rally actually occurred; the round-table/member-recruitment activities are not coded as public gatherings. A separate 28 February result records BNP condemnation of police action at Ganatantra Mancha and is treated as reaction/context for E001, not a separate event or independent turnout evidence.
